label: ROX Dimensions · Portrait
description: Dark 4:5 portrait card (Instagram feed) explaining the four ROX categories from momentifyapp.com/what-is-rox as a 2x2 grid: numeral 01-04 in each category's accent, the category name, and a one-line blurb per category. Names and accents are fixed brand facts; only the blurbs are editable. General pillar.

slots.label: Conversion Effectiveness blurb
